y-m-07-06.title: Makadhi enhamba 3: chigadzirwa chinova chikuru kupi?
y-m-07-06.topic: Kutsvaga nyaya dzine chigadzirwa chikuru kana uchigadzira mitauro ye (nhamba yemadhijiti maviri)×(nhamba yedhijiti imwe) nemakadhi enhamba
y-m-07-06.goal: Edza pfungwa yekuti "kana ukagadzira nhamba yemadhijiti maviri yakakura zvikuru, chigadzirwa chinovawo chikuru zvikuru" nekugadzira mitauro iwe pachako, tsvaga mitauro yakawanda ine chigadzirwa chikuru, uye unyore kuti nei.
y-m-07-06.material: Pane kadhi rimwe rega rega renhamba 3, 5, ne7. Shandisa kadhi rega rega kamwe chete kugadzira mutauro we (nhamba yemadhijiti maviri)×(nhamba yedhijiti imwe). Semuenzaniso, isa 3 ne5 padivi nedivi kugadzira 35 uye uwanze ne7, zvichipa 35×7 (makumi matatu nemashanu nguva nomwe). Usadzosera makadhi. Harin akati, "Kana ndikagadzira nhamba yemadhijiti maviri yakakura zvikuru, 75, ndikaiwanza ne3, chigadzirwa chichava chikuru zvikuru!"
y-m-07-06.prereq.1: Maitiro ekugadzira nhamba yemadhijiti maviri nemakadhi enhamba (nzvimbo yetens, nzvimbo yeones)
y-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwaunogona kuita zvino nezvezvakataurwa naHarin.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira mumwe mutauro kunze kwe75×3, uuverenge iwe pachako, uye ufananidze zvigadzirwa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga waverenga kuti pane mitauro mingani muhuwandu inogona kugadzirwa nemakadhi 3.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama. Kana nhamba yemadhijiti maviri iri huru zvikuru, chigadzirwa chinovawo chikuru zvikuru.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Nhamba yedhijiti imwe yaunowanza nayo inochinjawo zvichienderana nemakadhi. Haufanire kutarisa nhamba yemadhijiti maviri chete.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Hatisati taziva. Tinofanira kuifananidza nezvigadzirwa zvemamwe marongerwo emakadhi.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakaona kuti unofanira kuedza kana chirevo chakarurama nekufananidza nemimwe mitauro. Kutonga kwakanaka kwekuedza kuunganidza humbowo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Hazvioneki zvakarurama. Multiplier 3 idiki, saka zvinogona kuva kurasikirwa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakacherekedza kuti multiplier inova diki. Asi sezvo ichifungidziro, unofanira kuongorora nekufananidza nemimwe mitauro.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Chigadzirwa chakafanana chero uchiisa sei, saka hapana chikonzero chekufananidza.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Usati wasarudza kuti zvigadzirwa zvakafanana, verenga mitauro mishoma iwe pachako. Inogona kuva yakasiyana zvikuru.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: 75×3=225. Kana ukaverenga mimwe mitauro, pane zvigadzirwa zvakakura, seye 35×7=245. Chirevo chaHarin hachirurami, asi kuedza mitauro mishoma kutanga nzira yakanaka yekuongorora.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.acc.0: Iyi ifungidziro inonzwisisika. Asi sezvo ichifungidziro, unofanira kuwana zvigadzirwa iwe pachako kuongorora.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitauro 2 yakasiyana ine chigadzirwa chikuru kupfuura 240. Kadhi retens i t, kadhi reones i u, uye kadhi rekuwanza i m. Unofanira kushandisa makadhi 3, 5, ne7 kamwe chete rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Isa kadhi rimwe pazvose nzvimbo yetens, nzvimbo yeones, nenzvimbo yemultiplier uye uverenge chigadzirwa.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Uchitora chigadzirwa che75×3 sechiyero, fananidza kuti chigadzirwa chinochinja sei kana ukachinja nzvimbo yaunoisa 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nzvimbo dzose tatu ndedzimwe ye3, 5, kana 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Wakashandisa kadhi rega rega kamwe chete.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Haufanire kushandisa kadhi rimwe kaviri. Unofanira kushandisa 3, 5, ne7 kamwe chete rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Chigadzirwa hachikure kupfuura 240. Edza kuchinja nzvimbo dzemakadhi.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Pane mitauro 6 muhuwandu inogona kugadzirwa nemakadhi 3. Pakati peiyoyo, mitauro 3 yakakura kupfuura 240, uye 35×7=245 imwe mienzaniso. 75×3 yaHarin i225, saka haisvike pa240.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Pakati pemitauro 6 inogona kugadzirwa nemakadhi 3, 5, ne7, mutauro upi une chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru? Nyorawo kuti nei nzira yaHarin (75×3) isina kupa chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga zvigadzirwa zvemitauro yose 6, uzvinyore mutebhura, uye udzungudze chikuru zvikuru.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Fananidza kuti kadhi ripi ndiro multiplier mumutauro une chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru nemumutauro waHarin.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Mutauro une chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru i ... Nzira yaHarin ... nokuti ...
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakasarudza chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru mushure mekuverenga zvose 6 here?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafananidza kuti 7 yakaiswa kupi mumutauro waHarin nemumutauro une chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru here?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora nemashoko ako kuti nei nzira ye "gadzira nhamba yemadhijiti maviri chete ikure" isingakwani here?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru i53×7=371. Kana ukagadzira 75 seHarin, multiplier i3, saka 75×3=225 idiki. Kushandisa nhamba huru 7 semultiplier kwakanga kwakakura.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.1: Kushandisa 7 semultiplier uye kugadzira 53 nezvasara, 53×7=371, ndicho chikuru zvikuru. 75×3=225, saka nzira yaHarin yakanga isina kururama.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.2: Mutauro une chigadzirwa chikuru zvikuru i53×7. Muna 75×3, multiplier idiki 3, saka yakanga isiri chikuru zvikuru.

y-m-07-05.title: 1/2 ne1/4 yeribhoni: ndiani akashandisa zvakawanda?
y-m-07-05.topic: Mafractions anogona kufananidzwa muhukuru chete kana yose yakafanana (mafractions eyose dzakasiyana)

y-m-07-05.material: Jian akashandisa 1/2 yeribhoni tsvuku, uye Doyun akashandisa 1/4 yeribhoni blue. Hatizivi kana maribhoni maviri aiva nekureba kumwe chete pakutanga. Ribhoni rega rega rakanga riri rimwe rechidimbu risina kuchekwa, uye 1/2 ne1/4 zvinoreva yose yeribhoni remunhu mumwe nemumwe yakapatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zvakaenzana. 1/2 inoverengwa "hafu imwe" uye 1/4 inoverengwa "chikamu chimwe pa4."

y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakacherekedza kuti fraction iri nezve "yose yayo pachayo." Funga kuti ruzivo rupi rwakawanda rwaizokubvumira kusarudza.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.b: 1/2 yakakura kupfuura 1/4 chete kana yafananidzwa muyose imwe chete. Tanga wanyatsotarisa kana yose yemaribhoni maviri yakafanana.

y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.c: Denominator hombe haiiti kuti kureba kwakashandiswa kureba. Kana yose dzakasiyana, kuti i ma cm mangani kunochinja.

y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.d: Hapana hwaro hwekutaura kuti "zvishoma." Edza nenhamba kuti chii chinoitika kana maribhoni ane yose dzakasiyana.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.explain: 1/2 yakakura kupfuura 1/4 kana yafananidzwa muyose imwe chete (maribhoni ane kureba kwakafanana). Semuenzaniso, kana ribhoni tsvuku i20cm, 1/2 i10cm, asi kana ribhoni blue i80cm, 1/4 i20cm, iri refu kupfuura, uye kana ribhoni blue i8cm, 1/4 i2cm, iri pfupi kupfuura. Unofanira kuziva kureba kwemaribhoni maviri kuti usarudze.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvikamu zvose zveruzivo zvinoita kuti, nekungoziva chimwe chete ichocho, unogona kusarudza kuti ndiani akashandisa zvakawanda. (Funga sarudzo imwe neimwe zvakasiyana.)
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira ruzivo rwechokwadi, isa ribhoni tsvuku pa20cm, gadzira mienzaniso yekureba kweribhoni blue imwe nenguva, uye uwane kureba kwakashandiswa nevanhu vaviri.

y-m-07-02.title: Mabhegi 6 ane mabhora 47 rimwe nerimwe, nzira nhatu dzekuverenga
y-m-07-02.topic: Nzira dzakati wandei dzekuverenga (two-digit number)×(one-digit number) nekupatsanura nhamba
y-m-07-02.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise mutsetse usina kururama munzira dzekuverenga nekupatsanura nhamba, uye utarise nemuenzaniso wako kuti kuita kupatsanura nenzira dzakasiyana kunopa huwandu hwakafanana, wobva wataura nei.
y-m-07-02.material: Pane mabhora 47 muhegi rimwe nerimwe, uye kune mabhegi 6 zvose. Shamwari nhatu dzakawana huwandu hwose hwemabhora nekushandura 47 kuita nhamba iri nyore kuverenga. Maitiro ekuverenga: 47×6 inoverengwa se 'forty-seven times six'.
y-m-07-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira nzira dzakati wandei dzekupatsanura mukati memamiriro
y-m-07-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura nei mhedzisiro dzakafanana kunyange nzira dzakasiyana
y-m-07-02.s.s1.prompt: Uku i kuverenga kwashamwari nhatu. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe apo kuverenga kusina kururama.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waenzanisa mutsetse nemutsetse kuti shamwari nhatu dzakanyora zvakare 47 sei.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba dzakashandiswa neshamwari nhatu ne 47, uye utarise mutsetse nemutsetse kana dzakawedzera kana kubvisa.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 haurarami. Doha akaona 47 se "3 shoma kupfuura 50," saka kubva ku 50×6=300 anofanira kubvisa 3×6=18, izvo zvinopa 300−18=282. Kuwedzera kunoita sekunge akaverenga ne 53 panzvimbo ye 47. Kuverenga kwaJian naSeoa zvose kunopa 282 imwechete.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuverenga 47×6 nekupatsanura 47 kuita nhamba mbiri a ne b. Gadzira kupatsanura 3 kwakasiyana kuri nyore kuverenga. Mamiriro: a ne b i natural numbers uye a+b=47. Uye imwe pamaviri inofanira kuva nhamba inooneka mutebhura rekuwanza re 5s (multiple ye 5). Kupatsanura kuita 40 ne 7 nekupatsanura kuita 7 ne 40 kunoverengwa sekupatsanura kumwechete.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kana a ne b zvichiwedzera kusvika 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba kubva mutebhura rekuwanza re 5s, ubvise kubva ku 47, uye uwane imwe nhamba.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva natural numbers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwe a ne b hahusi 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Imwe pamaviri i nhamba iri mutebhura rekuwanza re 5s.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Imwe pa a ne b inofanira kuva multiple ye 5 (5, 10, 15, ...).
y-m-07-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, 40+7, 45+2, 35+12, ne 30+17 zvose zvinowedzera kusvika 47 uye zvine nhamba imwe i multiple ye 5. Chero ukapatsanura sei, kuwedzera (nhamba yekupatsanura)×6 kunopa 47×6=282.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Kana wakaverenga kupatsanura kwega kwega kwawakagadzira, wakawana mabhora mangani? Mumitsara miviri kana mumwe, nyora nei mhedzisiro i imwechete kunyange nzira yekupatsanura yakasiyana.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora mhedzisiro yawakawana kune kupatsanura kwega kwega kwawakagadzira pane imwe nzvimbo uye uienzanise.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kana huwandu hwose hwemabhora hungachinja zvichienderana nenhevedzano yaunoverenga nayo mabhegi 6 e 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Pane mabhora ... Kunyange ndikachinja kupatsanura, ... nekuti ...
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa kuti mhedzisiro yaiva 282 imwechete kune kupatsanura kwose kwawakagadzira here?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora nemashoko ako kuti "kupatsanura 47, kuverenga, nekuisa zvakare pamwe chete" hakuchinji huwandu hwose hwemabhora here?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza mamiriro ekuti nhamba dzakapatsanurwa dzinowedzera kusvika 47 nechikonzero chekuti mhedzisiro i imwechete here?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Pane mabhora 282 zvose. Chero ukapatsanura 47 sei, uri kuisa zvakare pamwe chete kuverenga kwemabhegi 6 e 47 kwawakaverenga muzvikamu, saka huwandu hwose hunoramba hwakadaro.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndakawana mabhora 282. Kunyange ukawedzera 40×6 ne 7×6 kana 45×6 ne 2×6, huwandu hwose hwemabhora hwakafanana, saka mhedzisiro i imwechete.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ndakatsanangura nekupa mienzaniso miviri yangu ine nzira dzakasiyana dzekupatsanura.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Kunyange nzira dzekupatsanura dzakasiyana, mutengo we 47×6 i nhamba imwe chete, saka zvose zvinopa 282.

y-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa zvakaitwa naEunu kana nhamba yepamusoro yaiva shoma kupfuura yepasi, uye funga kana zvakafanana ne "kubvisa 285 kubva ku 603."
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.0: Nyora 603−285 wakamira uye uverenge kutanga ne ones place.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.1: Ones place: Haugone kubvisa 5 kubva ku 3, saka nyora 5−3=2.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.2: Tens place: Haugone kubvisa 8 kubva ku 0, saka nyora 8−0=8.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 ne mutsetse 3 hazvina kururama. Kana nhamba yepamusoro i shoma kupfuura yepasi uye usingagone kubvisa, Eunu akachinjanisa nhamba mbiri ndokubvisa. Mumamiriro iwayo, unofanira kutora 10 kubva panzvimbo iri pakarepo pamusoro uye ubvise (borrowing). Kuita nenzira iyi, 603−285=318.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzekuziva kuti mhinduro yaEunu 482 i inoshamisa.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kune nzira imwe neimwe yekutarisa, funga "kukanganisa kunooneka here kunyange ukaita kukanganisa kumwechete naEunu?"
y-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa nzira imwe neimwe yekutarisa kumhinduro yaEunwoo 482 uye unyore, nenhevedzano, kana kukanganisa kunooneka.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.a: Verenga zvakare kubva pakutanga nenzira imwechete naEunu.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukashandisa nzira imwechete, kukanganisa kumwechete kunodzokororwa uye mutengo mumwechete unobuda. Unoda nzira yakasiyana.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.b: Wedzera 482 ne 285 uye utarise kana uchiwana 603.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvakafunga kutarisa mhedzisiro yekubvisa nekudzoka nekuwedzera. I nzira yakasiyana nenzira yaEunu, saka inogona kubata kukanganisa.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.c: Tarisa kana mabhuku 482 asara ari mashoma kupfuura mabhuku 603 ekutanga.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.c: 482 i shoma kupfuura 603. Mhinduro isina kururama inopfuurawo mamiriro aya, saka izvi oga hazvigone kuburitsa kukanganisa.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.d: Fungidzira 603 ne 285 uye uone kuti mabhuku anosara anenge mangani.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.d: Iyi i nzira yekufungidzira nekuenzanisa ne 482. Unogona kuwana mhinduro iri kure usina kuverenga zvakadzama.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.explain: 482+285=767, iyo isiri 603, saka haina kururama. Uyewo, 603 i anenge 600 uye 285 i anenge 300, saka anenge mabhuku 300 asara, asi 482 i yakawanda zvikuru kupfuura izvozvo. Kuverenga zvakare nenzira imwechete kana kungotarisa kana 482 i shoma kupfuura 603 hakugone kuburitsa kukanganisa.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.acc.0: Kuongorora nekuwedzera kwakarurama. Tarisa kana unogonawo kuongorora nekufungidzira.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.acc.1: Wakawana nekufungidzira kuti iri kure. Tarisa kana pane nzirawo yekuongorora zvakarurama nekuwedzera.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.prompt: Pane kubvisa kunoita kuti nzira yaEunu (kubvisa nhamba diki kubva kukuru munzvimbo yega yega ndokunyora) irurame nemukana. Gadzira kubvisa 2 kwakasiyana apo kukosha kwakaverengwa nenzira yaEunu kuchienzana nemhedzisiro yakarurama. Bvisa nhamba yemadhijiti matatu b kubva panhamba yemadhijiti matatu a (a inofanira kuva huru kupfuura b). Nzira yaEunu ndeyekunyora musiyano wemadhijiti maviri (dhijiti hombe kubvisa dhijiti diki) munzvimbo yemahundred, tens, neones yega yega.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.0: Wana kukosha kwenzira yaEunu nekukosha kwenzira yakajairika uye ufananidze kana akafanana.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mutebhura kuti ndeipi yemadhijiti epamusoro nepazasi yakakura munzvimbo yega yega, uye utsvage kuti mienzaniso yakaipa neyakarurama inopatsanuka papi.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.ok.c1: a inhamba yemadhijiti matatu yakakura kupfuura b.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c1: a ne b dzinhamba dzechisikwa dzemadhijiti matatu uye a inofanira kuva huru kupfuura b.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Kukosha kwenzira yaEunu kunoenzana nemhedzisiro yakarurama.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Kukosha kwenzira yaEunu kwakasiyana nemhedzisiro yakarurama. Fananidza madhijiti munzvimbo yega yega.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, 587−243 inopa 7−3=4, 8−4=4, 5−2=3, saka nenzira yaEunu i344, uye mhedzisiro yakarurama i344 futi. Munyaya dzakadai, apo nzvimbo yega yega ine dhijiti yepamusoro yakakura kana yakaenzana nedhijiti yepazasi, hapana kukwereta kunodiwa, saka nzira yaEunu inorurama futi.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Kutarisa mienzaniso apo nzira yaEunu yakabuda yakarurama, ndekubvisa kwemhando ipi? Fananidza madhijiti munzvimbo yega yega uye unyore mitsara 1 kana 2.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Isa mienzaniso yawakagadzira padivi nedivi uye unyore mutebhura kuti ndeipi yakakura, dhijiti yepamusoro kana yepazasi, munzvimbo yega yega.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Muna 603−285, apo nzira yaEunu yakaipa, tsvaga uye ufananidze kuti munzvimbo ipi dhijiti yepamusoro yakadiki kupfuura yepazasi.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Munzvimbo yega yega, dhijiti yepamusoro i ...
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Mumienzaniso yawakagadzira, wakaongorora kuti pakanga pasina nzvimbo apo dhijiti yepamusoro yaidiki kupfuura yepazasi here?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora zvinoreva "hapana kukwereta kunodiwa" nemashoko ako here?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Unogona kubatanidza kuti nzvimbo ipi yakaputsa mamiriro aya muenzaniso wakaipa (603−285) here?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.0: Kwaiva kubvisa pasina kukwereta. Muna 587−243, seye 7−3, 8−4, ne5−2, dhijiti yepamusoro yakakura kupfuura yepazasi munzvimbo yega yega, saka kuita seEunu kunorurama futi.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Zvaiva zvakarurama kana dhijiti yepamusoro yakakura kana yakaenzana nedhijiti yepazasi munzvimbo yega yega. Kwaiva kubvisa apo hauna kufanira kukwereta.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Ndakanyora mamiriro ekuti hapana kukwereta kunodiwa nemashoko angu.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.2: Inoshanda kana nhamba yepamusoro iri huru munzvimbo yega yega. Muna 603−285, yakaipa nokuti munzvimbo yeones 3 idiki kupfuura 5.

y-m-07-03.title: Kuverenga kumwechete, asi mhinduro inochinja nenyaya imwe neimwe
y-m-07-03.topic: Mamiriro apo quotient ne remainder mukugovanisa kune remainder zvinoshandiswa zvakasiyana munyaya dzakasiyana
y-m-07-03.goal: Tsanangura mhedzisiro (quotient, remainder) yekugovanisa kune remainder kuti ienderane nemubvunzo mu nyaya, uye gadzira nyaya iwe pachako apo kuverenga kumwechete kunopa mhinduro dzakasiyana.
y-m-07-03.material: Pa autumn field trip, vadzidzi 50 vanokwira ngarava. Ngarava dzose dzehukuru hwakafanana uye imwe neimwe inogona kutakura vanhu 8 zvakanyanya. Hapana mudzidzi anogona kusiiwa. Kana uchiverenga 50÷8 (makumi mashanu akagovaniswa neasere), quotient i 6 uye remainder i 2. Unogona kutarisa izvi ne 8×6+2=50.
y-m-07-03.thinking.0: Kutsanangura mhedzisiro yemasvomhu kuti ienderane nemubvunzo mumamiriro
y-m-07-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira nyaya dzinopa mhinduro dzakasiyana kuverenga kumwechete
y-m-07-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva quotient ne remainder mukugovanisa (remainder i shoma kupfuura divisor)
y-m-07-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuti vadzidzi vose 50 vakwire, panofanira kuva nengarava dzingani zvishoma?
y-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza vanhu 8 pangarava imwe mumufananidzo kana tebhura uye uverenge kuti ngarava dzingani dzakazara.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wana kuti vanhu vangani vasara mushure mengarava dzakazara, uye funga kuti vanhu avo vanofanira kukwira kupi.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakaverenga quotient 6 zvakananga sehuwandu hwengarava. Tarisa kana vamwe vadzidzi vasina kukwanisa kukwira mungarava 6 dzakazara.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakaverenga huwandu hwevanhu 8 sehuwandu hwengarava. 8 i huwandu hwevanhu vanogona kutakurwa nengarava imwe.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakaverenga remainder 2 sehuwandu hwengarava. 2 i huwandu hwevanhu vasara.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvakaisa mumhedzisiro yekuverenga mamiriro ekuti vadzidzi vasara vanoda nzvimbo yekukwira.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.explain: Ngarava 6 dzinotakura vanhu 48 uye 2 vasara. Vanhu 2 vasara vanofanira kukwirawo, saka ngarava imwe yakawanda inodiwa, izvo zvinoita ngarava 7. Munyaya iyi, mhinduro haisi quotient 6 asi nhamba 1 yakakura kupfuura quotient.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.prompt: Kana huwandu hwevadzidzi huchichinja, huwandu hwengarava dzinodiwa hunochinjawo. Gadzira mamiriro 3 apo ngarava 10 chaizvo dzinodiwa uye ngarava yekupedzisira haina kuzadzwa. Huwandu hwevadzidzi i n uye hukuru hwengarava imwe i c. Hukuru i natural number kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 9, uye vadzidzi vose vanofanira kukwira.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza hukuru, wobva wachinja huwandu hwevadzidzi padyo nemutengo wekuwedzera hukuru ka9, uye uverenge ngarava dzinodiwa.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wasarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi, wana quotient ne remainder yekugovanisa uye utarise kana vadzidzi vasara.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi nehukuru zvi natural numbers.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi nehukuru zvinofanira kuva natural numbers.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Hukuru hunofanira kuva vanhu 2 kusvika ku 9.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana huwandu hwevadzidzi hunogovaniswa nehukuru, ngarava dzose dzakazara. Ngarava yekupedzisira inofanira kuva isina kuzara.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Kuti vadzidzi vose vakwire, ngarava 10 chaizvo dzinodiwa.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ngarava dzinodiwa hadzisi 10. Govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi nehukuru uye utarise ngarava dzakazara nevadzidzi vasara.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, nevadzidzi 75 nehukuru 8, quotient ye 75÷8 i 9 uye remainder i 3. Vadzidzi 3 vasara mushure mengarava 9 dzakazara vanoda ngarava imwe yakawanda, saka i 10. Kunyange nehukuru hwakafanana, zvichienderana nehuwandu hwevadzidzi quotient inogona kuramba iri imwechete nepo remainder chete ichichinja.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.prompt: Uchishandisa kuverenga kumwechete 50÷8=6…2 (quotient 6, remainder 2), gadzira nyaya imwe apo mhinduro i 6 neimwe apo mhinduro i 2. Ita shuwa kuti unoshandisa 50 ne 8 munyaya.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.0: Funga dzimwe nyaya dzekugovanisa zvinhu mumidziyo kana kugovanisa kutenga, sekutenga zvinhu ne 50원.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza kana mubvunzo wekupedzisira wenyaya yako uchibvunza "kangani/zvingani unogona kuisa" kana "zvingani zvasara."
y-m-07-03.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Nyaya apo mhinduro i 6: ... / Nyaya apo mhinduro i 2: ...
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Munyaya apo mhinduro i 6, mubvunzo unobvunza "quotient" here?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Munyaya apo mhinduro i 2, mubvunzo unobvunza "chii chasara" here?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Nyaya dzose mbiri dzinoshandisa 50 ne 8 sezvadziri, uye kuverenga kwakafanana ne 50÷8 here?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.model.0: Mhinduro 6: Kana ukatenga maswiti e 8원 ne 50원, unogona kutenga 6. Mhinduro 2: Kana ukasunga mabhuku 50 mumabhandi e 8, mabhuku 2 anosara.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.model.1: Mhinduro 6: Kana ukacheka tambo ye 50cm kuita zvidimbu ze 8cm, unowana zvidimbu 6. Mhinduro 2: Kana ukagovana maswiti 50 zvakaenzana pakati pevanhu 8, munhu wese anowana 6 uye 2 dzinosara.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndakajekesa kuti mubvunzo wenyaya yechipiri i "huwandu hwakasara."

y-m-07-01.title: Ndingatenga snack ne drink nemari ye1000 won here?
y-m-07-01.topic: Kana uchifungidzira nhamba dze digit nhatu, unodzidza chii kana fungidziro yakaenzana nechiyero?
y-m-07-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kana fungidziro yakaenzana chaizvo nechiyero (1000 won), zvakaoma kusvika pamhedziso nekufungidzira oga. Gadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuti wakasimba sei nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwuchiuya, uye gadzira muenzaniso apo, kunyangwe nguva dzakafanana dzichienzana, makosha chaiwo anogona kuva kumativi ose maviri echiyero.
y-m-07-01.material: Hajun anoda kutenga snack imwe ne drink rimwe kuchitoro. Chikwama chake chine bhiri re1000 won rimwe chete. Mitengo yose ndema natural number mu won. Kana uchifungidzira kusvika pahundred yakaswedera, tenderedza kumusoro kana tens digit iri 5 kana kupfuura uye tenderedza kumasi kana iri 4 kana pasi. Semuenzaniso, 460 inofungidzirwa se500 uye 440 se400.
y-m-07-01.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa zvaunogona nezvisingagoni kutaurwa kubva pakukosha kwakafungidzirwa
y-m-07-01.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuti wakasimba sei sezvaunodzidza ruzivo rutsva
y-m-07-01.prereq.0: Kufungidzira nhamba dze digit nhatu kusvika pahundred yakaswedera (muenzaniso: 487 iri padhuze ne500)
y-m-07-01.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwenhamba dze digit nhatu
y-m-07-01.prereq.2: Kuziva kuti 1000 won ndi yakawanda sei (500 won+500 won)
y-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvinogona kutaurwa naHajun. Unogona kuchengeta kufunga kwako kwekare kana kukugadzirisa.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti mashoko ekuti "anenge 500 won" anoreva here kuti mutengo chaiwo ungava mukuru kana mudiki kupfuura 500 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti nhamba imwe neimwe itsva yakaratidzwa yakakura kana diki kupfuura 500 nezvakadini, uye uenzanise huwandu uhwo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Hajun akatarisa mitengo yakaiswa kure pamberi peshelufu. Akaverenga ose snack ne drink se "anenge 500 won." (Haasati aziva nhamba chaidzo.)
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: 1000 won yakakwana kutenga snack imwe ne drink rimwe here?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvose zvatinoziva ndezvekuti mitengo yose iri padhuze ne500 won. Fungidziro yehuwandu hwose yakaenzana nechiyero 1000, saka kubva pakufungidzira oga hatigoni kuziva kuti huwandu chaihwo hwakakura kana hudiki kupfuura 1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 500+500=1000, saka ndinogona kuzvitenga zvechokwadi ne1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kungoti fungidziro ndi1000 hakureve kuti huwandu chaihwo ndi1000. Fungidziro inogona kuva yakawanda kana shoma zvishoma kupfuura kukosha chaiko.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Fungidziro ndi1000, saka inopfuura 1000 won uye handigoni kuzvitenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Fungidziro 1000 yakaenzana nemari yandinayo, 1000 won. Kuti uti "inopfuura," yaifanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Fungidziro ndi1000 won chaizvo, saka zvakaoma kutonga nekufungidzira oga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakafunga kuti kana fungidziro yakaenzana nechiyero, kukosha chaiko kunogona kuva kukuru kana kudiki kupfuura chiyero.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Handizivi mitengo chaiyo, saka handigoni kutaura chinhu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Fungidziro inewo ruzivo rwunobatsira. Unoziva kuti mutengo mumwe nemumwe uri padhuze ne500 won. Verenga kuti unogona kuenda kure sei neruzivo irworwo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Paakaswedera ndokutarisa, snack yaiva 487 won uye drink raiva 518 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino, unofunga kuti huwandu hwemitengo miviri hunoenzaniswa sei ne1000 won?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.after: 487 ndi13 pasi pe500 uye 518 ndi18 pamusoro pe500, saka huwandu hwakapfuura 1000 ne5. Kuwedzera chaizvo, 487+518=1005. Kutonga kwekutanga kwekuti "zvakaoma kusarudza" kwakanga kuchiri kwakarurama, uye zvino pane chikonzero.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kuwedzera 18 kwakakura kupfuura kushoma 13, saka huwandu hwakakura kupfuura 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Izvi zvakawana kuti 518 ndi18 pamusoro pe500 uye 487 ndi13 pasi pe500, uye zvakaenzanisa huwandu hwakapfuura nehwakashoma. Inzira yakanaka yekutarisa makosha akafungidzirwa zvakare nenhamba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 487 iri pasi pe500, saka huwandu hwuri pasi pe1000 won zvakare.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Izvi zvakasiya chokwadi chekuti 518 yakakura kupfuura 500. Unofanira kutarisa kuti mutengo mumwe nemumwe unosiyana sei ne500 pamwe chete.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvose zviri padhuze ne500, saka huwandu ndi1000 won chaizvo sezvazviri.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Padhuze" hazvireve zvakafanana. Tsvaga musiyano pakati penhamba yechikwangwani chemutengo mumwe nemumwe ne500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kufungidzira oga hakundiudzi, saka ndichawedzera 487+518 chaizvo kuti nditonge.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunofunga kuti fungidziro haikwani uye kunoedza kutarisa nekuverenga chaizvo. Itsika yakanaka yekushandisa kufungidzira nekuverenga pamwe chete.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Hajun akawana mari 2 yakawanda ye10 won mukati mechikwama chake. Zvino mari yaanayo ndi1020 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Angataura chii kana atonga achisanganisira chokwadi chitsva?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1005원 i shoma kupfuura 1020원, saka anogona kuzvitenga uye 15원 inosara. Kunyange nemitengo imwechete, kana mari yaunayo ichichinja, mhedziso inochinja. Kutonga nekufungidzira 1000 oga kwakanga kwakarurama panguva ino, asi chikonzero chako chakanga chakaoma.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Huwandu hwose i 1005원, iri yakawanda kupfuura 1000원, saka haachagoni kuzvitenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Izvi hazvina kuisa makoyini matsva awanikwa mumari yaanayo. Tanga watarisa kana mari yaanayo yachinja.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Huwandu hwose 1005원 i shoma kupfuura mari yaanayo, 1020원, saka anogona kuzvitenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Izvi zvakaenzanisa zvakananga mari yaanayo yakachinja nehuwandu chaihwo. Zvakaratidza zvakanaka kuti ruzivo rutsva runochinja mamiriro.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Fungidziro 1000 i shoma kupfuura 1020, saka anogona kuzvitenga nekungotarisa fungidziro.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Mhedziso i imwechete, asi rangarira kuti fungidziro nehuwandu chaihwo zvakasiyana sei. Kuenzanisa ma estimates kune mumwe kunoomesa kuvimba kana musiyano uri mudiki.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 1005 ne 1020 zvakafanana, saka hatigone kuziva kuti ndeipi hombe.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 1005 ne 1020 zvinogona kuenzaniswa pakarepo. Enzanisa hukuru hwenhamba kuona kuti ndeipi hombe.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.reflect: Kubva pachirevo chekuti fungidziro yekutanga yaiva 1000, chii chaunogona kuziva uye chii chausingagone kuziva? Mushure mekuona nhamba chaidzo pama price tags, uye mushure mekuwana makoyini mamwe, pfungwa dzako kana kuvimba kwako zvakachinja sei? Kana wakachengeta pfungwa dzako dzekutanga sezvadzakaita, taura nei zvakare.

y-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: 487+518=1005 i yakakura kupfuura 1000, uye 480+510=990 i shoma kupfuura 1000. Kunyange ma estimates akafanana, 1000, huwandu chaihwo hunogona kuva kumativi ose maviri e benchmark. Saka kana fungidziro yakaenzana ne benchmark, usatonge nekufungidzira oga; tarisa zvakanyatsonaka.
